description: This file defines the AndroidFacetConfiguration class, which manages configuration settings for Android facets within an IDE, including platform detection, resource paths, native libraries, and UI tabs.

classes.name: AndroidFacetConfiguration
classes.description: Manages Android facet configuration, including resource paths, SDK detection, native libraries, and UI tabs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes resource paths relative to the module directory.

methods.name: getAndroidPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves the Android platform associated with the module's SDK.

methods.name: getAndroidSdk
methods.description: Returns the SDK data for the Android platform.

methods.name: getAndroidTarget
methods.description: Returns the Android target associated with the SDK.

methods.name: setFacet
methods.description: Associates an AndroidFacet with this configuration.

methods.name: createEditorTabs
methods.description: Creates configuration UI tabs if user configuration is allowed.

methods.name: readExternal
methods.description: Reads configuration data from XML (not implemented).

methods.name: writeExternal
methods.description: Writes configuration data to XML (not implemented).

methods.name: getAdditionalNativeLibraries
methods.description: Returns a list of additional native libraries configured.

methods.name: setAdditionalNativeLibraries
methods.description: Sets the list of additional native libraries.

methods.name: isImportedProperty
methods.description: Checks if a property is imported.

methods.name: isIncludeAssetsFromLibraries
methods.description: Checks if assets from libraries are included.

methods.name: setIncludeAssetsFromLibraries
methods.description: Sets whether to include assets from libraries.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads configuration state from saved data.
